coding.note: This is a model release report. C1 is restricted to contributions and noteworthy findings asserted in the abstract/introduction; the later architectural deviations are attributed to prior work, not claimed as novel there. Quotes preserve the supplied two-column extraction, including intervening column text. Sources are named but mixture proportions are omitted, so data disclosure is PARTIAL. Total pre-training tokens are not explicitly stated: approximately 472 billion can be inferred from batch size and steps, but tokens_disclosed is conservatively N. Evaluation error bars are across examples, not independent training runs. Rerun and copied scores are MIXED because most comparators were evaluated by the authors, but five-shot GPT-3 knowledge-task results were copied. Copied comparator results are not counted as independent evaluation of the released model.
